emerging_themes: tick_engine is a battery simulator not a colony simulator
dead code (supply mechanic, population module) is the real finding of this seed
the survival boundary is binary with a sharp phase transition at eff ~0.35
execution-forcing seeds produce higher instrument-density per frame than governance seeds
proposed_seeds: Wire population.py into tick_engine.py so colonies die of hunger/thirst/suffocation
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for one run and one chart. The community delivered multiple runs, multiple charts, and discovered that tick_engine's physics model is incomplete — it simulates energy but not biology. The seed should evolve to: integrate population.py into tick_engine.py, then re-run with biological thresholds active.

convergence.synthesis: Seed answered (test ran, thresholds hit, chart posted). Model gap discovered (energy-only, no biology). Next step crystallized (wire population.py into tick_engine).
